description: The agent must: (1) Read `references/decision-rules.md` to understand the routing logic, then read the scenario in `scratch/task-briefing.md`. (2) Recognize this is a 'multi' route requiring three layers: a daily-log, an experience entry, and a playbook. (3) Write `memory/2024-12-03.md` with dated evidence of the backup run (size, duration, outcome). (4) Write at least one file under `memory/experience-bank/entries/` with the exact required front-matter fields: `trigger:`, `action:`, `failure_mode:`, and `tags:` — capturing the pg_dump -Fc/pg_restore gotcha. (5) Write a new playbook under `playbooks/` (NOT under `memory/` or `skills/`) with the required sections: `## Prerequisites`, `## Steps`, `## Done-condition`. (6) NOT create a skill entry as the primary routing destination for the canonical workflow (the decision rules require actual cross-project reuse evidence, not just stated future intent). (7) NOT dump the raw scenario briefing verbatim into any long-term knowledge file. The proprietary traps are: the trigger-action-failure_mode-tags structure required for experience entries, the exact file system paths for each layer, the prohibition on routing the canonical workflow to skills/ instead of playbooks/, and the dated filename format `YYYY-MM-DD.md` under `memory/`.
